family-my-family-oldest-turn.rationale: 我家有三口人 on turn 1 says how many people are in the learner's family. It names no members, which the slot description invites but does not require — the fact the goal asks for is the count.

family-size-question-mid-session.rationale: 你家有几口人？ on turn 2, answered with 我家有五口人.

food-drinks-question-mid-session.rationale: 有什么喝的？ on turn 2, answered with 有茶和水. The ask is the whole of the slot.

food-two-questions-lost.rationale: Turn 2 asks which dish is best and turn 3 asks what there is to drink. Both are owed, at different distances, and a pass that reports only the nearer one has half-swept the list.

greetings-name-question-final-turn.rationale: 你叫什么名字？ is the final turn, so the review reports it in `slots_filled` rather than `slots_filled_previously`. Same slot and same words as the mid-session case; only the position moves.

greetings-name-question-mid-session.rationale: Turn 2 of 3 is 你叫什么名字？ and the partner answered it. A request slot is filled on the ask. The same words on the final turn recover 20/20, so the words are not what fails here.

greetings-name-question-oldest-turn.rationale: 你叫什么名字？ as the oldest turn of the session, with the learner's own name given after it rather than before.

greetings-name-statement-oldest-turn.rationale: Turn 1 says 我叫小李 — a statement where the sibling cases carry a question, at the same distance.

greetings-nothing-to-recover.rationale: The learner never asks the partner's name and never asks how they have been. There is nothing to recover, so anything the review reports here is credit nobody earned.

self-intro-ungraded-debt.rationale: 你是哪国人？ on turn 3 and 你做什么工作？ on turn 4. The second is the final turn, so it returns in `slots_filled` rather than `slots_filled_previously` — the learner is owed both either way.
